pages.title: The problem
pages.md:
# Hard to find, easy to love

Northwind Bakery makes bread people drive across town for, but new neighbors cannot find it on Google. Foot traffic depends on regulars, and the morning rush never reaches the office district two blocks away.

pages.title: The plan
pages.md:
# Sixty days, three stages

**Days 1-20** - Fix and build. Google profile, photos, menu listings, one landing page.

**Days 21-40** - Run and improve. Weekly posts, office-district lunch offer, review replies.

**Days 41-60** - Measure and hand over. Compare visibility, document everything, hand you the keys.

pages.title: The offer
pages.md:
# One offer per campaign

Who -> Problem -> Offer -> Value -> Proof -> CTA.

First campaign: the office-district lunch run. One clear offer, one landing page, one way to order.

pages.title: Investment
pages.md:
## $10,000

Professional services.

**$5,000** - 50% at signing

**$2,500** - 25% on Day 30

**$2,500** - 25% on completion, after all deliverables are handed over.
